## What the scan found, and a caveat that matters

The scanner reports **17 typed rows, all of them vendored `kyo.compat` types** from `typesafe4s-compat-ce`
(`CIO`, `CStream`, `CFiber`, `CPromise`, `CLatch`, `CChannel`, `CChunk`, `CLocal`, `CMeter`, the four `CAtomic*`).
There are **zero typesafe4s domain types** — nothing specified has been implemented.

> ⚠️ **Those rows show the CATS EFFECT shapes** (`CIO` over `IO[A]`, `CStream` over `fs2.Stream`), because that is
> the binding whose source lives in this repository. On the zio / ox / kyo / pekko rows the same names resolve to
> entirely different underlying types. **Never read a `kyo.compat` inventory row as universal.** The carrier's
> contract is the compat API, not any one binding's representation.

They are still worth recording: a spec must not define its own `CIO`, and a reviewer should know these names are
taken.

## Behavioral Concepts (registry pass)

**registry-check.sh**: `OK (0 implementation-map tokens verified, 0 spec concept references checked, 0 EARS references checked, 0 weak binding(s) to tighten)`

**Stale implementation-map rows**: none — every Implementation map is deliberately empty. The registry was adopted
**before** the code exists, so filling a map is part of implementing the spec that realizes it. A speculative
symbol would fail the symbol pass, which is why none was written.

**Unregistered actions / syncs / state components**: none — there is no code to be unregistered.

The registry was created in this change with **8 concepts**, sourced from the TypeSafe API documentation and this
change's own specs rather than from code:
[Evaluation](../../concepts/evaluation.md), [Noul](../../concepts/noul.md), [Choice](../../concepts/choice.md),
[Score](../../concepts/score.md), [Confidence](../../concepts/confidence.md),
[TokenBudget](../../concepts/token-budget.md), [Retry](../../concepts/retry.md),
[Credential](../../concepts/credential.md), plus 6 synchronizations.

**Deliberately not a concept:** effect portability. It is a realization strategy with no state and no actions of
its own — it changes the type every action returns. Recorded in `openspec/concepts/README.md` and verified by
Ring 5, not modelled here.

| Evaluation | behavioural | *not implemented* | introduce — `question-model`, `wire-codec` |

These value domains have no authoritative source in the repository and are marked in the concept files. The apply
phase must stop rather than invent them (task 12.3 confirms them against a live key):

| Domain | Concept | Why unconfirmed |
|---|---|---|
| `Retry-After` / `retry-after-ms` header names | [Retry](../../concepts/retry.md) | taken from SDK prose, no published schema |
| 529 Overloaded semantics | [Retry](../../concepts/retry.md) | in the HTTP reference, absent from the Python exception tree |
| `GET /v1/models` response shape | [Evaluation](../../concepts/evaluation.md) | described in prose only |
| Confidence formula | [Confidence](../../concepts/confidence.md) | not published — treat as opaque, never assert an exact value |
| Tokenizer | [TokenBudget](../../concepts/token-budget.md) | not published — any estimator is approximate and must over-estimate |
| API key format | [Credential](../../concepts/credential.md) | not published — do not validate locally |
